name: WorldConnectionsMap
job: Show where a business operates or ships to, as a dotted world map with glowing arcs linking locations
visitor_action: hover/focus a location to highlight its connections and show its label; keyboard tab through locations
mobile: map scales to container width; collision-aware labels show only the active location plus up to 3 that fit
motion: arcs draw in with travelling light pulses, subtle dot shimmer (reduced-motion: arcs drawn static, no pulses)

checks.portable_rules_lint: self-checked: SSR-safe render, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, flat single-class selectors, logical properties, no viewport @media, no transition: all

art_direction: Arctic night: midnight blue-black, cool slate dots, ice-cyan arcs with white-hot pulses, faint aurora-teal glow; light variant is frost-blue with deep-cyan arcs. Material: glass label chips over a dotted land layer, grain overlay.
